node.title: XR window-divisor maximality filter: RAW_d fiber identity and the mandatory exact-core plus selected-liveness predicates
node.statement: If MAX_e counts maximal joint codeword pairs of full core size k+e and RAW_d counts all degree-(n-k-d) locators satisfying both linear window systems, then RAW_d=SUM_{e>=d} MAX_e*C(k+e,k+d). Thus a deeper pair contributes no depth-d selected occupancy but contributes C(k+e,k+d) raw divisors; the raw affine-divisor count is not equivalent to SL-2 and can exceed 17n^2/25 from one deeper pair. The residual must require exact maximality and L_P>=2 under first-match selection. Full rank d of each single-word system also does not imply joint codimension 2d.
